title: 12 導程 ECG 與 PPG 設備：怎麼和「黃金標準」比較？HRV 設備驗證入門
description: 分清楚 12 導程 ECG、連續 ECG、胸帶與腕式 PPG 在驗證中的角色，並整理比較流程、一致性統計與常見錯誤。
titleEn: 12-Lead ECG and PPG Devices: How to Compare Them With a Gold Standard—An Introduction to HRV Device Validation
descriptionEn: Clarifies the roles of 12-lead ECG, continuous ECG, chest straps, and wrist PPG in validation, and lays out the comparison workflow, agreement statistics, and common mistakes.

title: 運動與情緒學習地圖：從情緒的定義、量測到證據解讀
description: 從情緒、心情與情感的區分出發，連結運動劑量、候選機制、自陳與行為與生理量測、研究設計陷阱及證據解讀。
titleEn: Exercise and Emotion Learning Map: From Definitions and Measurement to Reading the Evidence
descriptionEn: Starts from the difference between emotion, mood, and affect, then links exercise dose, candidate mechanisms, self-report, behavioral and physiological measures, design pitfalls, and how to read the evidence.

title: 停止訊號作業的來龍去脈：從延遲訊號到賽跑模型
description: 從早期的延遲訊號研究、Logan 的賽跑模型到 SSRT 的估計，整理停止訊號作業的背景、假設、估計方法與延伸典範。
titleEn: The Stop-Signal Task in Context: From Delayed Signals to the Race Model
descriptionEn: Background on the stop-signal task: early delayed-signal studies, the race model, how SSRT is estimated and when it should not be reported, and extensions such as selective stopping and emotional stimuli.

title: 貝氏因果推論學習筆記 05：隨機化不只是抽籤——從估計目標到區組設計
description: 從 Perfect Doctor、邊際與聯合分布、CRE 與 Bernoulli 隨機化，理解 estimand、estimator、Horvitz–Thompson 加權與區組設計。
titleEn: Bayesian Causal Inference Notes 05: Randomization Is More Than a Coin Flip—From Estimands to Block Designs
descriptionEn: From the Perfect Doctor example, marginal versus joint distributions, and completely randomized versus Bernoulli designs to estimands, estimators, Horvitz–Thompson weighting, and blocked designs.

title: 貝氏因果推論學習筆記 04：只靠隨機分派，如何得到精確 p 值？
description: 從 Fisher 嚴格虛無假設、隨機化分配與蒙地卡羅近似，理解不依賴常態假設的精確檢定，以及事後挑選統計量的風險。
titleEn: Bayesian Causal Inference Notes 04: How Can Random Assignment Alone Give an Exact p Value?
descriptionEn: Fisher's sharp null, the randomization distribution, and Monte Carlo approximation: how to run an exact test that does not rely on normality, and why choosing the test statistic after seeing the data is risky.

title: 貝氏因果推論學習筆記 03：從風險差到因果圖——哪些變數該控制？
description: 從 RD、RR、OR 與 Fisher 精確檢定，進入潛在結果、SUTVA、混淆變數、對撞變數、中介與工具變數，理解控制變數必須依因果結構決定。
titleEn: Bayesian Causal Inference Notes 03: From Risk Difference to Causal Graphs—Which Variables Should You Control?
descriptionEn: From RD, RR, OR, and Fisher's exact test to potential outcomes, SUTVA, confounders, colliders, mediators, and instruments, and why covariate adjustment must follow the causal structure.

title: 貝氏因果推論學習筆記 02：沒有隨機實驗，傾向分數能幫上什麼忙？
description: 從觀察性資料的混淆問題出發，理解傾向分數、交換性與重疊性，並區分有限母體和超母體推論回答的不同問題。
titleEn: Bayesian Causal Inference Notes 02: Without a Randomized Experiment, What Can Propensity Scores Do?
descriptionEn: Starting from confounding in observational data: propensity scores, exchangeability, and overlap, and how finite-population and super-population inference answer different questions.

title: 貝氏因果推論學習筆記 01：兩組平均數不同，為什麼還不等於因果效果？
description: 從 TMS 例子理解潛在結果、反事實、隨機分派、混淆與因果識別，並釐清 Bayesian 建模之前必須先回答的研究問題。
titleEn: Bayesian Causal Inference Notes 01: Two Group Means Differ—Why Is That Still Not a Causal Effect?
descriptionEn: Using a TMS example to understand potential outcomes, counterfactuals, random assignment, confounding, and causal identification, and the research questions that must be answered before any Bayesian modeling.

title: 從 BBI／RRI 到可比較的 HRV：我的 Garmin、Portable ECG 與 BIOPAC 分析實作
description: 以兩人三設備先導專案為例，拆解共同時間窗、R peak、BBI／RRI 品質控制、HRV 指標、敏感度分析與重複量測一致性限制。
titleEn: From BBI/RRI to Comparable HRV: Analyzing Garmin, Portable ECG, and BIOPAC Data
descriptionEn: A two-person, three-device pilot used to walk through shared time windows, R-peak detection, BBI/RRI quality control, HRV indices, sensitivity analysis, and the limits of repeated-measures agreement.

title: 從 What'Sub 事件看 Vibe Coding 的資安第一課：功能會動，不代表可以上線
description: 解析 Gary Chen 的非技術人員資安教學影片：從 What'Sub 爆紅引發的資安風波出發，盤點 AI 輔助開發（Vibe Coding）上線前必須回答的 5 個核心問題，並提供非工程背景也能落實的「四步驟安全修補法」。
titleEn: A First Security Lesson from the What'Sub Incident: Working Code Is Not Ready for Production
descriptionEn: Based on a security tutorial for non-engineers: five questions to answer before shipping AI-assisted (vibe-coded) software, plus a practical four-step hardening routine that does not require an engineering background.

title: Garmin 可以取代 ECG 嗎？從公開證據到兩人三設備先導實驗
description: 整合Garmin公開驗證研究與兩人三設備先導結果，分層解讀靜息Mean HR、Mean NN、SDNN、RMSSD及動作QC，並建立正式方法比較研究路徑。
titleEn: Can a Garmin Watch Replace ECG? From Published Evidence to a Two-Person, Three-Device Pilot
descriptionEn: Combines published Garmin validation studies with pilot results, interprets resting mean HR, mean NN, SDNN, RMSSD, and motion QC by tier, and outlines a formal method-comparison study.

title: 走進山林，身體和情緒會發生什麼？戶外健行的多層次效益
description: 從整合性綜述理解健行如何同時結合運動、自然與社會刺激，整理心肺、情緒與社區效益，也辨認健行和一般步行不能混為一談的證據限制。
titleEn: What Happens to Body and Mood When You Walk into the Mountains? The Layered Benefits of Hiking
descriptionEn: An integrative review of how hiking combines exercise, nature, and social stimulation; cardiorespiratory, emotional, and community benefits; and why hiking evidence cannot simply be equated with ordinary walking.

title: 傳統醫學與現代身體科學：跨領域科普系列
description: 規劃中醫人體觀、運動傷害、情緒與認知、美顏科學及研究判讀五條跨領域文章路線，並建立論文圖片授權、證據分級與安全說明規則。
titleEn: Traditional Medicine and Modern Body Science: An Interdisciplinary Series
descriptionEn: A plan for five article tracks—traditional views of the body, sports injury, emotion and cognition, aesthetic science, and reading research critically—with rules for figure licensing, evidence grading, and safety statements.

title: 漢方藥可能保護腎功能嗎？從九年觀察研究讀懂 eGFR 與傾向分數配對
description: 解析長期日本漢方萃取製劑與腎功能變化的配對觀察研究，說明 eGFR slope、傾向分數、主要結果及無法直接推論因果的原因。
titleEn: Could Kampo Extracts Protect Kidney Function? Reading eGFR and Propensity-Score Matching in a Nine-Year Observational Study
descriptionEn: Unpacks a matched observational study of long-term Japanese Kampo extract use and kidney function: eGFR slope, propensity scores, the main results, and why causation cannot be inferred directly.

title: 從一次心跳開始：BBI、RRI、IBI 與 NNI 到底有什麼不同？
description: HRV 每日學習第一篇：從 ECG R peak、腕式 PPG 脈搏波與品質控制，分清 IBI、BBI、RRI、PPI 與 NNI。
titleEn: Starting from a Single Heartbeat: What Are the Differences Among BBI, RRI, IBI, and NNI?
descriptionEn: The first daily HRV lesson: telling IBI, BBI, RRI, PPI, and NNI apart, from ECG R peaks and wrist PPG pulse waves to quality control.

title: 訊號失真與數據缺損的救星：DVC 自適應高斯填補法如何拯救你的心率變異度（HRV）
description: 介紹 Benchekroun et al. (2022) 發表於 Sensors 期刊的動態 HRV 預處理方法（DVC）。探討智慧手錶/手環在運動與日常中產生連續斷訊與偽峰時，如何透過自適應高斯採樣還原心臟天然波動特徵，提高壓力預測與自律神經評估的精準度。
titleEn: Rescuing Corrupted and Missing Signals: How DVC Adaptive Gaussian Imputation Protects Heart Rate Variability (HRV)
descriptionEn: Introduces the dynamic HRV preprocessing method (DVC) of Benchekroun et al. (2022, Sensors): how adaptive Gaussian sampling restores natural cardiac variability when smartwatches lose signal or produce artifact peaks during exercise and daily life.

title: 認知神經科學學習地圖：從大腦、認知到情緒
description: 以神經系統基礎、認知功能、情緒機制、研究方法與整合推論五層，建立可學習、複習與深化的認知神經科學路徑。
titleEn: Cognitive Neuroscience Learning Map: From the Brain to Cognition and Emotion
descriptionEn: A five-layer path—neural foundations, cognitive functions, emotion mechanisms, research methods, and integrative inference—designed for learning, review, and deepening.

title: 運動生理學學習地圖：從急性反應到運動處方
description: 由能量代謝、神經肌肉與心肺反應，逐步進入訓練適應、測量與個別化運動處方。
titleEn: Exercise Physiology Learning Map: From Acute Responses to Exercise Prescription
descriptionEn: From energy metabolism and neuromuscular and cardiorespiratory responses to training adaptation, measurement, and individualized exercise prescription.

title: 人體解剖學學習地圖：用結構理解動作與生理
description: 從解剖方位、組織與器官系統出發，把肌肉骨骼、神經與心肺結構連回動作、傷害與生理量測。
titleEn: Human Anatomy Learning Map: Understanding Movement and Physiology Through Structure
descriptionEn: From anatomical position, tissues, and organ systems, connecting musculoskeletal, nervous, and cardiopulmonary structures to movement, injury, and physiological measurement.

title: 運動傷害防護學習地圖：從風險辨識到重返運動
description: 整理預防、臨床評估、急性照護、治療介入、復健與重返運動的循證學習路徑。
titleEn: Athletic Training Learning Map: From Risk Identification to Return to Sport
descriptionEn: An evidence-based path through prevention, clinical assessment, acute care, treatment, rehabilitation, and return to sport.

title: EEG 學習地圖：從神經生理、設備到可重現分析
description: 把腦電生理、電極與放大器、實驗設計、前處理、時頻分析及品質控制連成完整路徑。
titleEn: EEG Learning Map: From Neurophysiology and Equipment to Reproducible Analysis
descriptionEn: Links brain electrophysiology, electrodes and amplifiers, experimental design, preprocessing, time-frequency analysis, and quality control into one path.

title: HRV 學習地圖：從自律神經、感測設備到指標解讀
description: 從心臟與自律神經生理、ECG／PPG 量測，到 BBI 清理、時域、頻域、非線性指標及研究解讀。
titleEn: HRV Learning Map: From the Autonomic Nervous System and Sensors to Interpreting Indices
descriptionEn: From cardiac and autonomic physiology and ECG/PPG measurement to BBI cleaning, time-domain, frequency-domain, and nonlinear indices, and research interpretation.

title: 從「減重」到「心臟調頻」：馬拉松長跑與 HIIT 對自律神經的重塑奇蹟
description: 介紹 Wang et al. (2025) 的最新運動介入研究：為期兩個月的馬拉松慢跑與 HIIT，如何顯著調降青年族群的體重與 BMI，並對心臟副交感迷走神經活性（RMSSD、pNN50）進行深度的適應性重塑。
titleEn: Beyond Weight Loss: How Marathon Running and HIIT Retune the Autonomic Nervous System
descriptionEn: Summarizes Wang et al. (2025): a two-month marathon-running and HIIT intervention in young adults that reduced body weight and BMI and remodeled cardiac parasympathetic (vagal) activity (RMSSD, pNN50).

title: 從 Notion 單字庫到 Podcast：可查核的 Antigravity × NotebookLM 單字工作流
description: 用 Notion 收集可追溯的單字與語境，讓 Antigravity 產生待確認草稿，再把已查核內容匯入 NotebookLM 製作 Audio Overview；同時說明資料結構、安全、人工驗證與學習成效評估。
titleEn: From a Notion Word Bank to a Podcast: A Verifiable Antigravity × NotebookLM Vocabulary Workflow
descriptionEn: Collect traceable words and contexts in Notion, let Antigravity draft items for review, then import verified content into NotebookLM for an Audio Overview—covering data structure, safety, human verification, and learning evaluation.

title: 自製進修課程雷達：自動化追蹤 EMT-1 與運動傷害防護課程
description: 從分散的 AT、EMT-1 公開課程，到 Python 清洗、Supabase 資料與權限管理、Vercel 靜態部署及 fallback 快照，完整拆解進修課程雷達的功能、架構、安全與資料品質。
titleEn: Building a Continuing-Education Course Radar for EMT-1 and Athletic Training
descriptionEn: From scattered public AT and EMT-1 listings to Python cleaning, Supabase data and access control, static Vercel deployment, and fallback snapshots: the tool's features, architecture, security, and data quality.

title: FFT 與小波分析：從整段頻譜到 EEG 時間－頻率地圖
description: 從 sampling、Nyquist、頻率解析度與 spectral leakage，到 STFT、Morlet cycles、baseline 與 edge effects，並用互動工具比較 FFT 與小波結果。
titleEn: FFT and Wavelets: From a Whole-Signal Spectrum to an EEG Time–Frequency Map
descriptionEn: Sampling, the Nyquist limit, frequency resolution, and spectral leakage; STFT, Morlet cycles, baselines, and edge effects; with an interactive tool comparing FFT and wavelet results.

title: 資料類型與 Tidy Data：如何把研究資料整理成可分析的格式？
description: 從測量尺度、觀察單位與長寬格式，到資料字典、缺失值及驗證規則，建立能被正確理解與重現的研究資料。
titleEn: Data Types and Tidy Data: Organizing Research Data into an Analyzable Format
descriptionEn: From measurement scales, units of observation, and long versus wide formats to data dictionaries, missing values, and validation rules, so that research data can be understood correctly and reproduced.

title: 不要只畫平均數：研究資料視覺化的選圖與判讀原則
description: 依資料型態與研究設計選圖，正確區分 SD、SE 與 CI，並用原始點、配對線與分布揭露長條圖容易隱藏的資訊。
titleEn: Don't Plot Only the Means: Choosing and Reading Research Figures
descriptionEn: Choose figures by data type and study design, distinguish SD, SE, and CI correctly, and use raw points, paired lines, and distributions to reveal what bar charts hide.

title: P 值不是假設為真的機率：從假設檢定到正確研究解讀
description: 釐清 p 值的條件機率定義、顯著與不顯著的常見誤解，以及如何結合效果估計、信賴區間與研究設計報告結果。
titleEn: A p Value Is Not the Probability That the Hypothesis Is True: From Hypothesis Testing to Sound Interpretation
descriptionEn: Clarifies the conditional-probability definition of p, common misreadings of significant and nonsignificant results, and how to report findings together with effect estimates, confidence intervals, and study design.

title: 效果量、信賴區間與樣本數：研究結果有多大、又有多確定？
description: 把原始與標準化效果、區間精確度、SESOI、power 與 precision-based planning 放進同一套研究規劃與結果判讀框架。
titleEn: Effect Size, Confidence Intervals, and Sample Size: How Big Is the Result, and How Certain Are We?
descriptionEn: Places raw and standardized effects, interval precision, SESOI, power, and precision-based planning in one framework for study planning and interpretation.

title: Claude、Codex、Antigravity、Hermes：我的 AI 研究團隊如何分工
description: 把四套 AI 工具安排成研究內容、程式實作、視覺驗證與長期排程的協作團隊，並建立避免檔案衝突、責任擴散與自動化偏誤的規則。
titleEn: Claude, Codex, Antigravity, and Hermes: How My AI Research Team Divides the Work
descriptionEn: Four AI tools arranged as a team for research content, code, visual verification, and scheduled tasks, with rules that prevent file conflicts, diffusion of responsibility, and automation bias.

title: Zotero、HackMD、NotebookLM 與 GitHub：研究資料到底該放哪裡？
description: 以單一事實來源與 FAIR 原則安排文獻、研究筆記、限定來源綜整、程式及版本，讓研究材料能互相連結又不產生多份衝突副本。
titleEn: Zotero, HackMD, NotebookLM, and GitHub: Where Should Research Material Live?
descriptionEn: Using a single source of truth and the FAIR principles to organize references, notes, source-limited synthesis, code, and versions so that materials link to each other without conflicting copies.

title: 從研究問題到可重現分析：我的 AI 輔助研究完整流程
description: 從 estimand、分析計畫、原始資料保護與品質檢查，到模型診斷、效果估計、敏感度分析及可重現發布，說明 AI 可以參與與不能代替的判斷。
titleEn: From Research Question to Reproducible Analysis: My AI-Assisted Research Workflow
descriptionEn: From estimand, analysis plan, raw-data protection, and quality checks to model diagnostics, effect estimation, sensitivity analysis, and reproducible release—what AI can contribute and which judgments it cannot replace.

title: 如何查核 AI 產生的統計分析結果？八道驗證閘門與實用清單
description: 不以流暢文字判斷統計正確性；逐層檢查研究設計、資料完整性、程式、模型假設、效果解釋、樣本數、AI 限制與引用證據。
titleEn: How to Audit AI-Generated Statistical Results: Eight Verification Gates and a Practical Checklist
descriptionEn: Fluent text is not evidence of correct statistics. Check design, data integrity, code, model assumptions, effect interpretation, sample size, AI limitations, and cited evidence layer by layer.

title: 體適能較好，注意力就更穩嗎？從 HRV 看認知作業中的心身調節
description: 解讀一項比較高、低體適能年輕男性的研究：較高體適能與持續注意反應及較穩定的 HRV 有關，但不是所有認知能力都較好。
titleEn: Does Better Fitness Mean Steadier Attention? Brain–Body Regulation in Cognitive Tasks, Seen Through HRV
descriptionEn: Interprets a study comparing young men with higher and lower fitness: higher fitness was associated with sustained-attention responses and steadier HRV, but not with better performance on every cognitive measure.

title: 開源研究 Skills 怎麼選？文獻、統計與研究寫作工具箱
description: 盤點具有明確 MIT、BSD-3-Clause 或 Apache-2.0 授權的學術研究與統計 Skills，說明用途、適用階段與再利用注意事項。
titleEn: Choosing Open-Source Research Skills: A Toolkit for Literature, Statistics, and Scientific Writing
descriptionEn: A survey of academic and statistics skills with clear MIT, BSD-3-Clause, or Apache-2.0 licenses, explaining their uses, suitable research stages, and reuse considerations.

title: 十套前端設計 Skills 都要裝嗎？以學術研究與個人網站為例的選擇指南
description: 比較十套熱門前端設計 Skills，辨認哪些適合研究視覺化、個人學術網站與長文呈現，以及為什麼安裝越多不一定越好。
titleEn: Do You Need All Ten Front-End Design Skills? A Selection Guide for Academic Research and Personal Websites
descriptionEn: Compares ten popular front-end design skills, identifies which suit research visualization, personal academic sites, and long-form pages, and explains why installing more is not always better.

title: 身體活動如何影響大腦健康？
description: 整理身體活動、認知功能、情緒調節與神經可塑性之間的重要連結。
titleEn: How Does Physical Activity Affect Brain Health?
descriptionEn: An overview of key links among physical activity, cognitive function, emotion regulation, and neuroplasticity.

title: 第一次的 AI Code 分享
description: 分享我如何將 AI 導入資料分析、程式除錯與網站開發的日常工作流程。
titleEn: My First Experience with AI Code
descriptionEn: How I bring AI into everyday data analysis, debugging, and website development.

title: 從研究設計到報告：Python 統計分析 Pipeline 的核心原則
description: 統計分析不只是執行檢定；從研究設計、資料驗證到效果量與報告，每一步都需要留下判斷依據。
titleEn: From Study Design to Report: Core Principles of a Python Statistics Pipeline
descriptionEn: Statistical analysis is more than running tests. From study design and data validation to effect sizes and reporting, every step should leave a record of the judgment behind it.

title: 統計不顯著後，要算 Post-hoc Power 嗎？從信賴區間看懂研究結果
description: Observed post-hoc power 常只是 p 值的回音；改用效果量、信賴區間、重要效果門檻與敏感度分析，才能分辨接近零與結果不精確。
titleEn: Should You Compute Post-hoc Power After a Nonsignificant Result? Reading Results Through Confidence Intervals
descriptionEn: Observed post-hoc power is often just an echo of the p value. Effect sizes, confidence intervals, smallest effects of interest, and sensitivity analysis distinguish a near-zero effect from an imprecise estimate.

title: 數據如何變成結論？從研究問題到可重現報告的分析流程
description: 數據分析不只是選檢定與計算 p 值；從問題定義、資料清理、探索、模型診斷到效果估計，整理一套能被檢查與重現的完整流程。
titleEn: How Does Data Become a Conclusion? An Analysis Workflow from Research Question to Reproducible Report
descriptionEn: Data analysis is more than choosing a test and computing p. A complete, checkable, and reproducible workflow from question definition, data cleaning, and exploration to model diagnostics and effect estimation.

title: EEG 前處理不是按下按鈕：八個步驟與品質檢查
description: 從原始腦電訊號到可分析資料，整理濾波、重參考、壞道、ICA 與品質紀錄的完整思路。
titleEn: EEG Preprocessing Is Not Pressing a Button: Eight Steps and Quality Checks
descriptionEn: From raw EEG to analyzable data: the reasoning behind filtering, re-referencing, bad channels, ICA, and quality records.

title: 反應時間與移動時間有何不同？認識瞬間移動認知作業
description: 用一個簡單的點擊作業，理解大腦開始反應與身體完成動作其實是兩段不同的歷程。
titleEn: Reaction Time Versus Movement Time: Understanding the Teleportation Cognitive Task
descriptionEn: A simple click task shows that when the brain begins to respond and when the body finishes the movement are two different processes.

title: 從手錶 PPG 到 HRV：交感、副交感與 Poincaré plot
description: 完整理解 BBI、ECG 與腕式 PPG 的量測原理，以及時域、頻域、Poincaré plot、entropy、DFA 與 RQA 等 HRV 指標的限制。
titleEn: From Wrist PPG to HRV: Sympathetic and Parasympathetic Activity and the Poincaré Plot
descriptionEn: How BBI, ECG, and wrist PPG measure heartbeats, and the limits of time-domain, frequency-domain, Poincaré, entropy, DFA, and RQA indices of HRV.

title: 讓 Hermes 每天把學術文章送到手機：免費模型、Telegram 與排程
description: 從 Hermes 架構、Session、Memory 與 Skills，到模型選擇、Telegram 安全設定及每天 8 點的 cronjob，完整建立可查核的學術文獻推送。
titleEn: Delivering Daily Scholarly Articles to Your Phone with Hermes: Free Models, Telegram, and Scheduling
descriptionEn: From Hermes architecture, sessions, memory, and skills to model choice, Telegram safety settings, and an 8 a.m. cron job: a complete, verifiable literature-push setup.

title: 把 AI 工具連接變成可重用 Skills：我的 GitHub 研究工作流
description: 用 AI-tools-skills 串接 Gemini Notebook、GitHub、Zotero 與 HackMD，再延伸到完整的學術研究技能流程。
titleEn: Turning AI Tool Connections into Reusable Skills: My GitHub Research Workflow
descriptionEn: Using AI-tools-skills to connect Gemini Notebook, GitHub, Zotero, and HackMD, then extending it into a complete academic research skill workflow.

title: 文獻篩選到計畫書撰寫：把 AI-academic-skills 拆成找、評、寫三步驟
description: 文獻篩選與計畫書撰寫是研究工作中最花時間的兩段流程。整理 AI-academic-skills 中的 litpilot、paper-review、paper-digest 與 research-grants，並加上把既有 Zotero 收藏與 NotebookLM 綜整一起納入評讀的串接流程。
titleEn: From Literature Screening to Grant Writing: AI-academic-skills in Three Steps—Find, Appraise, Write
descriptionEn: Literature screening and proposal writing are the two most time-consuming stages of research. This post organizes litpilot, paper-review, paper-digest, and research-grants, and adds a workflow that appraises an existing Zotero collection together with a NotebookLM synthesis.

title: 從 EMD、瞬時頻率到 HHSA：如何看見腦波的振幅調變？
description: 從非平穩與非線性的差異、EMD 與 IMF，到 HHSA 的 carrier × AM frequency 表徵，完整說明分析流程、應用邊界與可重現研究要點。
titleEn: From EMD and Instantaneous Frequency to HHSA: How Can We See Amplitude Modulation in Brain Waves?
descriptionEn: From nonstationary versus nonlinear signals, EMD, and IMFs to the carrier × AM-frequency representation of HHSA: the analysis workflow, application boundaries, and reproducibility points.

title: 規則悄悄換了，你多快發現？認識圖卡分類作業與認知彈性
description: 圖卡分類作業用雙重規則系統測量認知彈性：切換代價與難度負荷兩個指標，分別代表規則轉換與選項增加的認知成本。
titleEn: The Rule Quietly Changed—How Fast Do You Notice? The Card-Sorting Task and Cognitive Flexibility
descriptionEn: The card-sorting task uses a dual-rule system to measure cognitive flexibility with two indices, switch cost and difficulty load, reflecting the cost of changing rules and of adding options.

title: 當直覺是錯的，你需要多久踩剎車？認識方向感作業與抑制控制
description: 方向感作業用一致／不一致箭頭測量抑制控制：從一致性效果到 Delta Plot、Gratton Effect，拆解抑制歷程的動態變化。
titleEn: When Your Instinct Is Wrong, How Long Do You Need to Brake? The Direction Task and Inhibitory Control
descriptionEn: The direction task uses congruent and incongruent arrows to measure inhibitory control, from the congruency effect to delta plots and the Gratton effect, showing how inhibition changes dynamically.

title: 記住位置還不夠，要在腦中走一遍：認識路徑終點 II 與空間工作記憶
description: 路徑終點 II 作業要求玩家記住箭頭位置與方向，並在腦中模擬沿路徑行走，同時涉及空間工作記憶與抗干擾能力。
titleEn: Remembering Locations Is Not Enough—You Must Walk Through Them in Your Head: PathEnd II and Spatial Working Memory
descriptionEn: PathEnd II asks players to remember arrow positions and directions and mentally simulate walking along the path, engaging spatial working memory and resistance to interference.

title: 記住內容不夠，還要記住順序：認識順向點擊作業與工作記憶廣度
description: 順向點擊作業是 Corsi 積木敲擊測驗的數位化版本，測量視覺空間工作記憶廣度，並拆解出校正動作時間後的純記憶處理指標。
titleEn: Remembering Content Is Not Enough—You Must Remember Order: The Forward Click Task and Working Memory Span
descriptionEn: The forward click task is a digital version of the Corsi block-tapping test that measures visuospatial working memory span and extracts a pure memory index after correcting for movement time.
